question: After the focused test repair and final branch refresh, does one successful immutable ledger run on the exact final SHA provide sufficient reconciliation and consumer evidence for release enforcement?
rationale: The PR intentionally holds merge for immutable historical reconciliation, but the cited run is cancelled and older than the live head; release-owner judgment is required to accept the final artifact.

options.title: Require exact-final-head proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a successful ledger artifact for the final SHA is accepted by candidate, release-publish, and npm-publish consumers.

options.title: Stage enforcement separately
options.body: Land provenance generation and validation first, then enable mandatory publication blocking after a successful release rehearsal.

recommendation.title: Require exact-final-head proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a successful ledger artifact for the final SHA is accepted by candidate, release-publish, and npm-publish consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the publication-enforcement commits and is the strongest history-backed owner for accepting release-gate proof.
